## Dough Intent Coverage: Caught

**Story and revision.** SEED-325#review-junit-tests-in-intent, `.planning/seeds/SEED-325-junit-tests-in-intent.md`, at `4980feb6d2aabb7fafc087942c1e28c8c2b86e04`.

**Checked promise.** A configured Java location lists eligible nested `.java` tests, including the story’s `CalculatorTest.java` example. This check is limited to Java membership at the authenticated listing/read boundary.

**Fault.** In an isolated scratch checkout, removed only the Java extension entry at `src/skills/dough-makeme/scripts/intent-location-selection.mjs:13`. Maintained fixtures and assertions were unchanged.

**Maintained proof.** Ran the same focused command before the fault, with the fault, and after restoration:

```sh
caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard -- --workers=1 'backend-tests/intent/authenticated-read-intent-java.spec.ts'
```

Each recorded run selected and executed all three cases. Baseline: 3 passed, exit 0. Fault: the Java-kind cases with and without `include` failed; the explicit-sources case passed, exit 1. Restored: 3 passed, exit 0. The catching assertion was the exact authenticated inventory comparison at `dashboard/backend-tests/intent/authenticated-read-intent-java.spec.ts:103`; it received empty files and `unsupported-kind` instead of the configured Java paths.

**Independent wrong-behavior observation.** The scratch witness published MakeMe repository/settings with `kind: "java"`, `include: ["**/*Test.java"]`, the nested test and an unmatched helper. Separate real authenticated HTTP requests returned listing status 200 with `files: []` and `problem: "unsupported-kind"`; opening the selected test returned 404. Thus the maintained listing assertion caught the same wrong configured-source behavior. This does not independently assess every other story promise.

**Restoration.** An exit/signal trap protected the source backup. Restored bytes matched the original with `cmp`, the scratch Git state was clean, and the restored focused run passed. The owned scratch worktree was removed without force. Evidence remains outside checkout cleanup at `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-325-mqSLyh/`: `baseline-proof.json`, `fault-proof.json`, `restored-proof.json`, `fault-run.log`, `witness.mjs`, and `witness.json`.

**Next proof action.** Retain the existing exact inventory assertion; this fault supplies no evidence requiring stronger proof on the exercised path. It matches the already completed Java-support repair and creates no new repair decision.

**Execution conditions.** Checkout-local `npm ci`; 16-core macOS host on AC. Initial load was 38.30/26.35/17.21 with reclaimable memory and competing work. Kept this bounded backend-only selection at one worker under `caffeinate -s -i`; no timeout or coverage relaxation.

- **Test runtime.** 11,595.175 ms measured across the recorded baseline (4,162.787 ms), fault (4,293.264 ms), and restoration (3,139.124 ms) runner durations. An initial quiet passing baseline was repeated to obtain explicit selection/result records; its runner duration is unavailable and excluded from that sum.
